title: Current Virtual USB authority and scope
summary: The Current Library executable baseline remains oorexx_virtual_usb_v0.1-dev9.zip. The current repository/package candidate is dev11 (d052144c13e965fa7bc4e6bfbf1c0feed1cb7804eda6d11555e28f48661a33e3); it closes the independently reviewed stale-hidraw class-generation gap in dev10 without changing CTAP2, CTAPHID, descriptors, Raw Gadget EP0 or credential semantics. Clean presenter-owned HID/hidraw live qualification remains pending.
invariants: oorexx_virtual_usb_v0.1-dev9.zip remains the Current Library continuation baseline until a successor is promoted.
dev11 adds hidraw class-generation identity; public semantic APIs remain unchanged.
dev10 changes the live qualification timing/evidence path and release metadata only; public semantic APIs remain unchanged.
The application models a semantic USB device; native USB presentation belongs to providers.
Generic HID support is Virtual USB core functionality rather than FIDO-specific special casing.
No live browser/WebAuthn or FIDO certification claim exists until separately qualified.
procedure: Continue from dev9 source and its exact package/dependency evidence rather than reconstructing from earlier dev1/dev3 copies.
Treat live target results as additional qualification evidence, not as permission to silently change semantic behavior.

provenance.claim: README identifies the dev9 baseline, package capabilities, development boundaries and pending live-host acceptance.
dev10 candidate records delayed HID/hidraw publication as a qualification timing boundary and preserves dev9 provider semantics.

provenance.claim: dev11 records independent review, forcing stale-hidraw regression and the still-pending clean target-host gate.
